[color=#38761d][b]Ming 2.0.0 Su Town's Nature Update Out Now![/b][/color]
[color=#38761d][b]    Welcome to settle down here.[/b][/color]

重要说明：
本模组的庭园建筑结构较为复杂、细节较多。为了呈现更丰富的装修效果，部分结构需要相互穿插或重叠。但星露谷的地图图层系统无法完美渲染这些穿插关系，因此[b][color=#d5a6bd]部分地块会出现穿模现象[/color][/b]。这是为了视觉效果而难以避免的取舍，并非Bug，也不影响正常游玩。如果你比较介意穿模，请在安装前留意这一点。

Important Note:
Garden structures in this mod are highly detailed and complex. To create a richer decorative effect, some structures are designed to overlap or intersect. However, Stardew Valley's map layering system cannot perfectly render these overlaps, so [b][color=#d5a6bd]some tiles may show visual clipping[/color][/b]. This is an unavoidable visual trade-off, not a bug, and it does not affect normal gameplay. If visual clipping bothers you, please keep this in mind before installing.

已知问题：
1. 在玛妮家给庭园买动物时不会显示苏镇替换的贴图，是正常的
2. 鸭子硬代码似乎只能在初始农场中下水，在庭园里无法下水
3. 在苏镇地区退出存档时可能出现黄字报错，但是不影响游玩，具体内容大致为：
    [Misc Map Actions & Properties] No mushymato.MMAP/Panorama with Id 'elsa.MING_SuTownSky' found

和其他mod的冲突（不影响游玩）：
1. 如果有[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842][u]Mail Services Mod[/u][/url], 从CJB菜单中多次拿取带物品格子的家具会出红字且出现很多桌子，是此mod的冲突问题，不影响游玩，每次打开CJB只拿取一次不会出现此问题
2. 如果有[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911][u]Horse Overhaul[/u][/url]无法替换马厩贴图，在游戏主界面或者mod文件夹中修改HorseOverhaul的配置Disable Stable Sprite Changes为true
3. 如果有更好的工匠物品图标这类mod，（我用的是[url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases/tag/v1.6.6][u]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/u][/url]，版本1.6.6）可能会导致高级蜂箱产出风味蜂蜜时不会显示内部有蜂蜜的贴图，是这个mod的代码问题，仅仅是视觉效果影响，产出野蜂蜜是正常显示的；另外如果高级蜂箱产出风味蜂蜜时整个贴图出错变为原版物品，更新到我用的这个版本即可

Known Issues:
1. When buying animals from Marnie's for the gardens, it won't show Su Town's building textures: it's normal
2. Ducks seem to be hard-coded to only swim on the starting farm and cannot swim in the gardens.
3. Yellow-text errors may appear when exiting a save when you're in Su Town, but they do not affect gameplay. The general content is:
    [Misc Map Actions & Properties] No mushymato.MMAP/Panorama with Id 'elsa.MING_SuTownSky' found

Conflicts with other mods ( won't affect gameplay ):
1. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842][u]Mail Services Mod[/u][/url], repeatedly taking furniture with item slots from the CJB menu may cause red errors and spawn many tables. This is a Mail Services Mod conflict and does not affect gameplay. Simply take items from CJB only once per menu opening to avoid this issue.
2. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911][u]Horse Overhaul[/u][/url] and you cannot replace the stable sprite. Change Horse Overhaul's config `Disable Stable Sprite Changes` to `true` in the game's main menu or the mod folder.
3. If you have mods like **Better Artisan Good Icons** (I use [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases/tag/v1.6.6][u]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/u][/url], version 1.6.6), the Advanced Bee House may not display the honey-filled texture when producing flavored honey. This is a code issue with that mod and is purely visual. Wild honey displays normally. Also, if the Advanced Bee House produces flavored honey and the entire sprite breaks into a vanilla big craftable, simply update to the version I'm using.

[/list][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]﻿[/color] ---- It will looks really beautiful in Su Town map. I highly recommend
you disable this configuration: "Enable trash outside farm", so you won't see trash in the river.[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]Compatiblity with Other NPC Mods[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=3]Now compatible with:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#ead1dc]  [color=#ead1dc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Seven Deadly Sins[/url]﻿﻿[/color][/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#ead1dc][size=3]  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]﻿Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ead1dc]  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]﻿[size=3]Downtown Zuzu[/size][/url]﻿[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ead1dc]  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]﻿[size=3]Jorts and Jean[/size][/url]﻿[/color][/*]
[/list][size=3]Other NPC mods are not guaranteed.[/size]

[center][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]If you encounter this[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[list=1]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're playing with an already-existed save, and the 1st day my NPCs stuck in their bed:[/color] It's normal for all NPCs I guess, just sleep to the 2nd day and their schedule will work properly[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're in the yard playing an event and the animals keep changing directions but never move:[/color] It's normal I guess, they will move normally when the event ends[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're feeding the Ming Doll and the text shows wrong:[/color] Did you change language after you launched the game? Just close the game and start again, and it would be fine[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you pass out in Ming's yard or home, and find your UI missing after wake up:[/color] Exit to Title and start your save again. I don't know why this would happen, but this bug is very rare to encounter.[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If time comes to 6 pm and you lag a few seconds:[/color] it's normal, the mod is changing map tiles to night version[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're just warped to another map, and your Lantern ring stops to glow for a few seconds:[/color] I made the Lantern ring glow by adding Custom Companions on it, which would adds 2 glowing entities and they cannot warp with you precisely. Currently I can't find a better way to make the ring glow, sorry T.T[/*]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you eat a Golden Loong Koi or a Jasmine Cake, and the buff says you got double buff level:[/color] These 2 food uses Spacecore's regenerate buff, and it leads to the real buff level is doubled as it says. So you actually get 4 Fish Level and 4 Luck Level eating a Golden Loong, and that is exactly what I meant.
[/*]
[/list][center][color=#e06666][size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size][/color][/center]

﻿If other mods add festivals (which will force that day's weather to be sunny), the weather report in Yeyu Inn Room may still display the weather before the change.

[center][color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Other Notes[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[list=1]
[*]English is not my first language. I’ve provided a basic translation to make the mod accessible. If you encounter any awkward phrasing or have suggestions for cultural nuances, please let me know kindly. I welcome any help to improve it![/*]
[*]Ming Doll's codes are writed by AI, since I don't know much about coding. But I've tested many times to ensure it has no bugs. I will upload the code to github it anyone wants to do something about it.[/*]
[*]This is my first large-scale expansion mod. If you encounter any bugs or something, please report kindly. Sorry for my lack of skills![/*]
[/list]
[quote]I may not be able to see posts on nexus in time. If you need, you can contact me via [color=#fff2cc][size=3][b] relsai@qq.com[/b][/size][/color][/quote]
